lines.text: Every month, she opened the same spreadsheet.
Thirty-three units. Every peso, typed by hand.
Invoices lived in a paper book. Repairs, somewhere in a chat.
And the people asking about a room? Gone, without a record.
So we gave her one system.
On her laptop, her ledger, in her own layout.
On their phones, tenants see their rent, and pay with GCash.
A repair lands on her board, and the tenant watches it move to done.
A visitor asks about a vacant room, with no account, and she answers from the same place.
Nine hundred thirty-seven of her real records moved in. Graded A-plus for security. Rated four point five three, out of five.
Hivelet. One connected system, for the Fe Galang Da Silva Boarding House.
